The '''31st Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2020 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2019, were held at the [[Hollywood Palladium]] in [[Hollywood, Los Angeles|Hollywood]], [[California]] on January 18, 2020.<ref>{{cite web
